prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
New interactive flows (new_flow) generated the largest wins (up to +14.8%), but predictions were often overly optimistic as several recent flow additions caused severe drops (down to -11.8%).
Step reordering (reorder) achieved high-impact wins (up to +12.0%), but carried significant risk, frequently showing no clear effect or causing severe drops (down to -8.9%).
Wait-state indicators (wait_info) produced solid wins (up to +6.1%), at times exceeding optimistic predictions (+6.1% vs +3.2% predicted), though several variants showed no clear effect.
Targeted copy updates (copy) yielded selective wins (up to +6.7%), though the majority of copy tests produced no clear effect.
UI redesigns, layout changes, hints, notifications, and standalone preview screens failed to produce any wins, with redesigns (down to -19.3%) and hints (down to -3.1%) often causing significant declines.

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Companion Quick Trainer Flow: Introduces an interactive desktop command training flow during the generation wait time where users practice basic companion desktop controls. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s and mean of 2336s, while support emails show users are confused about how to control or hide the desktop pet post-onboarding.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Generation Stage Notification & Estimate: Adds active background ready notifications and time estimates to the waiting screen. (why: Home waiting duration averages 2336 seconds, causing potential drop-offs; wait-state indicators have historically generated strong wins up to +6.1%.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Quick Command Setup Screen: Inserts a short desktop hotkey preference setup screen right before the final launch screen. (why: Gives users direct control over desktop shortcuts prior to launching, directly resolving support queries about pet controls.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Pet Sync Clarification Copy: Updates sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly mention account pet retrieval and sync. (why: The top support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
4: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Waiting Account Registration Order Shift: Moves the sign_in step to occur after the waiting step immediately before desktop launch. (why: Reordering sign_in closer to completion reduces early friction while capturing user intent when their pet is ready.)
5: [choose_path, new_flow] Companion Habitat Quick Quiz Selection Flow: Adds an interactive quick quiz flow on choose_path to help users pick their pet path. (why: Choose_path has a 78.3% conversion and high dwell time (514s mean); new interactive flows historically delivered the highest conversion gains (up to +14.8%).)
6: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Generation Progress Safety Notice: Adds a step counter and progress status hint on the adoption certificate screen to confirm trait safety. (why: Adoption step drops off 22.9% of users; wait status feedback reassures users during processing stages.)

scores.note: Addresses long wait times on home step, but interactive flows carry high implementation cost and performance volatility.
Wait-state indicators reliably mitigate long wait duration issues at low cost.
Adding new screens near completion consistently lowers conversion in past tests.
Directly targets the top support complaint with a low-cost, proven copy update.
Step reordering on sign_in showed minimal historical win (+0.4% over 8 tests) and high drop risk.
Interactive quiz addresses high dwell time on choose_path, offering strong potential lift despite flow risk.
Replicates a proven wait_info pattern (+6.1%) on a high drop-off step with low effort.
